# 1. Setup
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(GenomicRanges)
  library(Seurat)
  library(Matrix)
  library(AnnotationDbi)
  library(EnsDb.Hsapiens.v86)
})

set.seed(187)

SCRIPT_DIR   <- getwd()
PROJECT_ROOT <- file.path(SCRIPT_DIR, "..")
DATA_DIR     <- file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "data")
SCORE_DIR   <- file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "output/feature_scores")
OUT_DIR <- file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "output/xgBoost_outputs")
dir.create(OUT_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

```

# 2. Inputs/Parameters
```{r}
seurat_rds   <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "seo_RNA_ATAC_chr123.rds")
consensus_rds <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "consensus_peak_set.rds")
consensus_bed <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "consensus_peaks.bed")

tss_file      <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "TSS.txt.gz")
snps_bed      <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "SNPs.bed.gz")
celltypes_tsv <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "celltypes.tsv")
celltype_col  <- "cell_type_manual"
keep_chr <- c("chr1","chr2","chr3")

# Output directory and filenames
data_tsv_path <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "data.tsv")
predictors_path <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "predictors.txt")
dropdups_path <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "drop_duplicates.txt")

keys_df <- read.delim(celltypes_tsv, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, strip.white = TRUE)
col_key <- if ("celltype_key" %in% names(keys_df)) "celltype_key" else names(keys_df)[1]
keys <- unique(trimws(keys_df[[col_key]]))
labels <- keys[!is.na(keys) & nzchar(keys)]

# Windows
link_kb <- 500  # TSS ± 500 kb candidate window
prom_kb <- 1    # TSS ± 1 kb promoter mask
```

# 4. Helpers
```{r}
agg_fun <- function(x) if (all(is.na(x))) NA_real_ else max(x, na.rm = TRUE)

stop_if_missing <- function(paths) {
  miss <- paths[!file.exists(paths)]
  if (length(miss)) stop("Missing files:\n - ", paste(miss, collapse = "\n - "))
}

normalize_feature_genes <- function(DT) {
  if (is.character(DT)) DT <- fread(DT)
  stopifnot(is.data.table(DT))
  gene_col <- intersect(names(DT), c("gene","Gene","gene_id","symbol","SYMBOL","GeneSymbol","GENE"))
  if (!length(gene_col)) stop("No gene column found. Columns: ", paste(names(DT), collapse=", "))
  setnames(DT, gene_col[1], "gene", skip_absent = TRUE)
  DT[, gene := trimws(as.character(gene))]
  peak_col <- intersect(names(DT), c("peak","Peak","peak_id","peakID"))
  if (!length(peak_col)) stop("No peak column found. Columns: ", paste(names(DT), collapse=", "))
  setnames(DT, peak_col[1], "peak", skip_absent = TRUE)
  unique(DT)
}

merge_left <- function(x, y, by) merge(x, y, by = by, all.x = TRUE, allow.cartesian = TRUE)

looks_like_ensembl <- function(x) {
  x <- na.omit(x)
  if (!length(x)) return(FALSE)
  mean(grepl("^ENSG\\d+", x)) > 0.5
}

map_ensembl_to_symbol <- function(ensembl_vec) {
  tx <- AnnotationDbi::select(EnsDb.Hsapiens.v86,
                              keys = unique(ensembl_vec),
                              keytype = "GENEID",
                              columns = c("SYMBOL"))
  tx <- unique(tx[!is.na(tx$SYMBOL), c("GENEID","SYMBOL")])
  setDT(tx); setkey(tx, GENEID)
  map <- tx[.(unique(ensembl_vec)), SYMBOL]
  names(map) <- unique(ensembl_vec)
  map
}

pseudobulk_logCPM <- function(counts_mat, groups_factor) {
  stopifnot(ncol(counts_mat) == length(groups_factor))
  groups_factor <- droplevels(groups_factor)
  
  # sum counts per group (features x groups)
  pb  <- Matrix::t(rowsum(Matrix::t(counts_mat), group = groups_factor))
  lib <- Matrix::colSums(pb); lib[lib == 0] <- 1
  val <- (pb * 1e6 + 1) %*% Diagonal(x = 1 / lib)  # ((1e6*PB + 1) / lib)
  logv <- log(val)
  DT <- as.data.table(as.matrix(logv), keep.rownames = "feature")
  setnames(DT, c("feature", levels(groups_factor)))
  melt(DT, id.vars = "feature",
       variable.name = "celltype",
       value.name = "logCPM",
       variable.factor = FALSE)[]
}
```

# 5. READ & FILTER BACKBONE
```{R}
message("Reading consensus peaks, TSS, and SNPs ...")
stop_if_missing(c(consensus_rds, tss_file, snps_bed))

consensus_peaks <- readRDS(consensus_rds)
gr_peaks <- consensus_peaks
gr_peaks <- keepSeqlevels(gr_peaks, keep_chr, pruning.mode = "coarse")

# add peak ID column 
mcols(gr_peaks)$peak <- sprintf("%s-%s-%s",
                                as.character(seqnames(gr_peaks)),
                                start(gr_peaks),
                                end(gr_peaks))


peaks <- data.table(
  chr   = as.character(seqnames(gr_peaks)),
  start = as.integer(start(gr_peaks)),
  end   = as.integer(end(gr_peaks))
)
peaks[, peak := sprintf("%s-%s-%s", chr, start, end)]

# TSS 
tss <- fread(tss_file)
if (!all(c("chr","tss","gene") %in% names(tss))) {
  stop("TSS file must contain columns: chr, tss, gene")
}
tss[, chr := paste0("chr", chr)]
tss <- tss[chr %in% keep_chr]
gr_tss <- GRanges(tss$chr, IRanges(tss$tss, tss$tss), gene = tss$gene)

gr_link <- promoters(gr_tss, upstream = link_kb*1000, downstream = link_kb*1000)
mcols(gr_link)$gene <- mcols(gr_tss)$gene
gr_prom <- promoters(gr_tss, upstream = prom_kb*1000, downstream = prom_kb*1000)
mcols(gr_prom)$gene <- mcols(gr_tss)$gene

message("Computing peak–gene candidates in ±", link_kb, " kb (excluding ±", prom_kb, " kb promoters) ...")
ov_link <- findOverlaps(gr_peaks, gr_link, ignore.strand = TRUE)
cand <- unique(data.table(
  peak = mcols(gr_peaks)$peak[queryHits(ov_link)],
  gene = mcols(gr_link)$gene [subjectHits(ov_link)]
))

ov_prom <- findOverlaps(gr_peaks, gr_prom, ignore.strand = TRUE)
peaks_in_prom <- unique(mcols(gr_peaks)$peak[queryHits(ov_prom)])
cand <- cand[!peak %in% peaks_in_prom]

# peak–gene distance (midpoint vs TSS), safety filter < link_kb
peaks_key <- peaks[, .(peak, chr, start, end)][, mid := (start + end) %/% 2L]
tss_key   <- tss  [, .(gene, chr, tss)]
setkey(peaks_key, peak)
setkey(tss_key, gene, chr)

cand <- merge(cand, peaks_key[, .(peak, mid, chr)], by = "peak", all.x = TRUE)
cand <- merge(cand, tss_key [, .(gene, chr, tss)], by = c("gene","chr"), all.x = TRUE)
cand[, peak_gene_distance := abs(mid - tss)]
cand <- cand[peak_gene_distance < link_kb*1000]
cand[, c("mid","tss","chr") := NULL]

# SNPs (filter to chr1-3)
snps <- fread(snps_bed, col.names = c("chr","start","end"))
snps[, `:=`(chr = as.character(chr), start = as.integer(start), end = as.integer(end))]
snps <- snps[chr %in% keep_chr]
snps[, snp := sprintf("%s-%s-%s", chr, start, end)]
gr_snps <- GRanges(snps$chr, IRanges(snps$start, snps$end))

message("Expanding peaks to overlapping SNPs ...")
ov_ps <- findOverlaps(gr_peaks, gr_snps, ignore.strand = TRUE)
peak_snp <- unique(data.table(
  peak = mcols(gr_peaks)$peak[queryHits(ov_ps)],
  snp  = snps$snp            [subjectHits(ov_ps)]
))

# Backbone: (snp, peak, gene, peak_gene_distance)
features <- merge(peak_snp, cand, by = "peak", allow.cartesian = TRUE)
setcolorder(features, c("snp","peak","gene","peak_gene_distance"))
```

# 6.  Merge Feature scores
```{r}
method_specs <- list(
  list(paths = signac_files,         score_col = "score",    out = "signac"),
  list(paths = scent_files,          score_col = "beta",     out = "scent"),
  list(paths = cicero_files,         score_col = "score",    out = "cicero"),
  list(paths = tad_sum_files,        score_col = "score",    out = "tad_sum_score"),
  list(paths = tad_pyt_files,        score_col = "score",    out = "tad_pyt_score"),
  list(paths = tad_boundaries_files, score_col = "score",    out = "tad_n_boundaries"),
  list(paths = conservation_files,   score_col = "score",    out = "conservation"),
  list(paths = rex_files,            score_col = "score",    out = "rex"),
  list(paths = atac_variance_files,  score_col = "var_atac", out = "ATACvariance"),
  list(paths = atac_mean_files,  score_col = "mean_atac", out = "ATACmean"),
  list(paths = predEnhancer_p_lin_score_files,  score_col = "score", out = "predEnhancer_p_lin_score"),
  list(paths = predEnhancer_p_lin_beta_files,  score_col = "beta", out = "predEnhancer_p_lin_beta"),
  list(paths = predEnhancer_p_exp_score_files,  score_col = "score", out = "predEnhancer_p_exp_score"),
  list(paths = predEnhancer_p_exp_beta_files,  score_col = "beta", out = "predEnhancer_p_exp_beta"),
  list(paths = predEnhancer_g_lin_score_files,  score_col = "score", out = "predEnhancer_g_lin_score"),
  list(paths = predEnhancer_g_lin_beta_files,  score_col = "beta", out = "predEnhancer_g_lin_beta"),
  list(paths = predEnhancer_g_exp_score_files,  score_col = "score", out = "predEnhancer_g_exp_score"),
  list(paths = predEnhancer_g_exp_beta_files,  score_col = "beta", out = "predEnhancer_g_exp_beta"),
  list(paths = distNearest_peakCentric_files,  score_col = "score", out = "distNearest_peakCentric"))

if (!all(lengths(lapply(method_specs, `[[`, "paths")) == length(labels))) {
  stop("Every method spec must have one file per label.")
}

read_method <- function(path, score_col, out_name, label) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    message("Skipping missing file: ", path)
    return(NULL)
  }
  DT <- normalize_feature_genes(fread(path))
  if (!(score_col %in% names(DT))) {
    stop(sprintf("Column '%s' not found in %s. Available: %s",
                 score_col, path, paste(names(DT), collapse=", ")))
  }
  setnames(DT, score_col, out_name)
  DT <- DT[, .(peak, gene, val = get(out_name))]
  setnames(DT, "val", sprintf("%s_%s", out_name, label))

  # diagnostics: how many overlap with features?
  common_peaks <- length(intersect(DT$peak, features$peak))
  common_genes <- length(intersect(DT$gene, features$gene))
  message(sprintf("[%s-%s] peaks overlap: %d, genes overlap: %d, rows: %d",
                  out_name, label, common_peaks, common_genes, nrow(DT)))

  DT[, lapply(.SD, agg_fun), by = .(peak, gene)]
}


message("Merging method scores ...")
for (i in seq_along(labels)) {
  lab <- labels[i]
  for (ms in method_specs) {
    mm <- read_method(ms$paths[i], ms$score_col, ms$out, lab)
    if (!is.null(mm)) {
      # after merge, report how many non-NA values were added
      before <- ncol(features)
      features <- merge_left(features, mm, by = c("peak","gene"))
      new_col <- setdiff(names(features), names(features)[1:(before)])
      if (length(new_col) == 1) {
        message(sprintf(" -> Added column %s, non-NA = %d",
                        new_col, sum(!is.na(features[[new_col]]))))
      }
    }
  }
}
# snp->chr and distances to TSS (closest flag)
snps_mid <- snps[, .(snp, chr, mid = start)]
features <- merge_left(features, snps_mid, by = "snp")
features <- merge_left(features, tss[, .(gene, chr, tss)], by = c("gene","chr"))
features[, snp_gene_distance := abs(mid - tss)]
features[, c("mid","tss") := NULL]

setorder(features, snp, snp_gene_distance)
closest <- features[, .SD[1L], by = snp][, .(snp, gene)]
closest[, closest_tss := 1L]
features <- merge_left(features, closest, by = c("snp","gene"))
features[is.na(closest_tss), closest_tss := 0L]
features[, chr := tstrsplit(snp, "-", fixed = TRUE, keep = 1L)]

```

# 7. Reshape to Wide
```{r}
score_suffixes <- paste0("_(", paste(labels, collapse="|"), ")$")
score_cols_all <- grep(score_suffixes, names(features), value = TRUE)

id_cols <- c("snp","gene","peak","snp_gene_distance","peak_gene_distance","closest_tss","chr")
long <- melt(
  features,
  id.vars      = intersect(id_cols, names(features)),
  measure.vars = score_cols_all,           # only columns that end with _<label>
  variable.name = "score_cell",
  value.name    = "value",
  variable.factor = FALSE
)

ylong[, score_cell_raw := score_cell]

# Extract the last token as putative celltype
long[, celltype := sub("^.*_", "", score_cell_raw)]

# Compute 'score' by stripping ONLY a trailing _<label>
ct_tail_pat <- paste0("_(?:", paste(labels, collapse="|"), ")$")
long[, score := sub(ct_tail_pat, "", score_cell_raw, perl = TRUE)]

# Drop anything whose tail isn't a real celltype (fixes 'g-exp-beta', 'g', 'n', etc.)
bad <- long[!celltype %chin% labels, unique(score_cell_raw)]
if (length(bad)) {
  warning("Dropping columns without a valid celltype suffix: ",
          paste(utils::head(bad, 10), collapse = ", "),
          if (length(bad) > 10) paste0(" ... (", length(bad)-10, " more)"))
}
long <- long[celltype %chin% labels]

# Clean up
long[, c("score_cell","score_cell_raw") := NULL]

# Cast to wide: one row per (snp, gene, peak, celltype, ...) and one column per 'score'
flat <- dcast(
  long,
  snp + gene + peak + celltype + snp_gene_distance + peak_gene_distance + closest_tss + chr ~ score,
  value.var = "value",
  fun.aggregate = agg_fun
)

# Base columns first
base_cols <- c("snp","gene","peak","celltype","snp_gene_distance","peak_gene_distance","closest_tss","chr")
score_cols <- setdiff(names(flat), base_cols)
setcolorder(flat, c(base_cols, score_cols))
stopifnot(length(score_cols) > 0L)
stopifnot(all(flat$celltype %chin% labels))
```

# 8. add logCPM features
```{r}
message("Loading Seurat object to compute logCPM (RNA/ATAC pseudobulk) ...")
seo <- readRDS(seurat_rds)
stopifnot(celltype_col %in% colnames(seo@meta.data))
seo <- subset(seo, cells = rownames(seo@meta.data)[seo@meta.data[[celltype_col]] %in% labels])

# Prepare celltype factor with desired order
seo@meta.data[[celltype_col]] <- factor(seo@meta.data[[celltype_col]], levels = labels)

# RNA: gene_logCPM
if ("RNA" %in% names(seo@assays)) {
  DefaultAssay(seo) <- "RNA"
  rna_counts <- GetAssayData(seo, assay = "RNA", slot = "counts") # genes x cells
  
  gene_names <- rownames(rna_counts)
  if (looks_like_ensembl(gene_names)) {
    map <- map_ensembl_to_symbol(gene_names)
    valid <- !is.na(map[gene_names]) & nzchar(map[gene_names])
    if (any(valid)) {
      sym <- map[gene_names]
      idx <- split(which(valid), sym[valid])  # indices per SYMBOL
      summed <- do.call(rbind, lapply(idx, function(ix) Matrix::colSums(rna_counts[ix, , drop = FALSE])))
      rna_counts_sym <- as(Matrix::Matrix(summed, sparse = TRUE), "dgCMatrix")
      rownames(rna_counts_sym) <- names(idx)
    } else {
      warning("ID mapping yielded no symbols; using original rownames.")
      rna_counts_sym <- rna_counts
    }
  } else {
    rna_counts_sym <- rna_counts
  }
  
  gene_log <- pseudobulk_logCPM(
    rna_counts_sym,
    factor(seo@meta.data[[celltype_col]], levels = labels)
  )
  setnames(gene_log, c("feature","celltype","logCPM"), c("gene","celltype","gene_logCPM"))
  gene_log <- gene_log[gene %in% unique(flat$gene) & celltype %in% labels]
  flat <- merge_left(flat, gene_log, by = c("gene","celltype"))
} else {
  warning("RNA assay not found; skipping gene_logCPM.")
}

# ATAC: peak_logCPM
if ("ATAC" %in% names(seo@assays)) {
  DefaultAssay(seo) <- "ATAC"
  atac_counts <- GetAssayData(seo, assay = "ATAC", slot = "counts") # peaks x cells
  
  # ensure "chr-start-end"
  peak_names <- rownames(atac_counts)
  if (any(grepl(":", peak_names))) {
    peak_names2 <- gsub(":", "-", peak_names)
    peak_names2 <- gsub("(chr\\w+)-(\\d+)-(\\d+)", "\\1-\\2-\\3", peak_names2)
    rownames(atac_counts) <- peak_names2
    peak_names <- peak_names2
  }
  # keep chr1-3 peaks
  keep_peaks <- grepl(paste0("^(", paste(keep_chr, collapse="|"), ")\\-\\d+\\-\\d+$"), peak_names)
  if (any(keep_peaks)) atac_counts <- atac_counts[keep_peaks, , drop = FALSE]
  
  peak_log <- pseudobulk_logCPM(
    atac_counts,
    factor(seo@meta.data[[celltype_col]], levels = labels)
  )
  setnames(peak_log, c("feature","celltype","logCPM"), c("peak","celltype","peak_logCPM"))
  peak_log <- peak_log[peak %in% unique(flat$peak) & celltype %in% labels]
  flat <- merge_left(flat, peak_log, by = c("peak","celltype"))
} else {
  warning("ATAC assay not found; skipping peak_logCPM.")
}
```

# 9. Write Outputs
```{r}
message("Writing new data.tsv ...")
fwrite(flat, data_tsv_path, sep = "\t")
message("Wrote: ", data_tsv_path)

# Update predictors list
score_cols <- setdiff(names(flat), base_cols)
new_pred_names <- c("gene_logCPM", "peak_logCPM")
preds <- c("snp_gene_distance","peak_gene_distance","closest_tss", score_cols)
writeLines(unique(c(preds, new_pred_names)), predictors_path)
writeLines("peak", dropdups_path)
message("Updated: ", predictors_path, " and ", dropdups_path)
message("Done.")
```
